temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth tells Keith she is not upset with him; she has been curt because she is dealing with personal stuff and apologizes if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth may be upset with him, possibly due to a misunderstanding or a mistake he made unknowingly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Elizabeth's explanation shifts his belief away from her being upset with him toward her behavior being caused by personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not angry with him; she is dealing with personal issues that are affecting her mood.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and supportive, without pressing her about being upset with him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts Keith's offer of a coffee break and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth is not upset with him but is under personal stress; he feels sympathetic and wants to offer support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; her acceptance confirms that his supportive offer is welcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth appreciates his support and is willing to spend time or talk with him.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Sympathetic and pleased that she accepted.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To listen and offer support during the coffee break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth shares more about her severe stresses and says she has thought about professional help but is hesitant and not sure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth's stress is severe and that professional help might benefit her, but he is concerned about suggesting it without offending her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; after he suggests professional help, he learns Elizabeth has considered it but is hesitant about seeking it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth may benefit from professional help but is currently hesitant and uncertain about it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support her and respect her hesitation while gently leaving room for help if she wants it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after his suggestion, then tells Keith he did not overstep and that she appreciates his concern, but it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes his suggestion about professional help may have embarrassed Elizabeth and that he may have overstepped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Elizabeth's reassurance changes his belief that he offended her, though he still sees she is processing a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He did not overstep; Elizabeth appreciates his concern but needs time to think.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful before her reassurance, then relieved but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her, give her space, and remain available for support without pushing professional help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative; she thanks Keith, says his support means a lot, and feels better knowing she has his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth values his support and feels more comfortable around him now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change; her explicit thanks and statement confirm and strengthen this belief.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better knowing she has it; their supportive relationship is positive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and remain available for chats or breaks.
